{{actor|name=ovl_Door_Toki|ispage=true}}

'''ovl_Door_Toki''' is the [[actor]] that manages the collision model for the [[Door of Time]]. It is spawned by [[ovl_Demo_Kankyo]], an actor that spawns various objects within the Temple of Time, specifically when ovl_Demo_Kankyo is set to take form of the Door of Time.  

{{clear}}

== Notes ==
{{Investigate|This actor is allocated immediately after ovl_Demo_Kankyo, meaning that actors can run routines before all actors set to spawn in the room file are initialized}}
